page.overview:
Who is Morvrin Thakanos?

Morvrin Thakanos is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

Morvrin is 5'5" tall, round-faced and stout, with graying hair, brown eyes, plump hands, and ample hips.

Morvrin is a placid sort, and sometimes has an absently vague look. She requires a great deal of proof for anything.

Morvrin is strong in the One Power for an Aes Sedai. Among the Salidar Six, she is equaled by Myrelle Berengari, Carlinya Sorevin and Anaiya Carel with only Sheriam Bayanar stronger and Beonin Marinye weaker. However Morvrin serves the distinction of being much more senior, having worn the shawl for more than a hundred and fifty years longer than the others.
